title: Bearframe all-owner-art import and fixed-tick memory QA verified
summary: PR 5 merge 058c0a1 CI 43238586201 passed Node and installed Android 35. Engine importer inventories all supplied archive files and nested ZIPs and packages real PNG/JPEG on-demand, byte-identical, with hashes and safe IDs; source-only files stay recorded. Real inspection found 3155 source members, 2946 .png filenames, 2905 true PNG, 39 JPEG mislabeled PNG, 2 macOS resource forks, 2944 usable runtime images, 1465 exact 32x32 tiles. Android memory-recovery scene test now compares identical presentation tick and live animation resumes; actual phone acceptance and mapping these images into gameplay scenes still open. No paid raw art uploaded to public repo.
